text.en: Put the salt into the pasta cooking water, not onto the cooked pasta.
text.de: Das Salz ins Nudelkochwasser geben, nicht erst auf die gekochten Nudeln.

why.en: The pasta takes up water and salt while it cooks; salt added afterwards does not season the same way.
why.de: Die Nudeln nehmen beim Garen Wasser und Salz auf; später zugegebenes Salz würzt nicht auf dieselbe Weise.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6 Pasta, section 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products
sources.sentence: Salt should be added to the water. Pasta absorbs water and salt during cooking.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 6 Pasta, section 6.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Pasta Products
sources.sentence: Adding salt to the pasta after it is cooked will not provide the same seasoning effect.
